'''Impact Armor''' was designed to help absorb some of the wear-and-tear [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could have encountered in an active workplace. The Impact Armor Mark II provided a decent, uniform covering and was the first in the series to be considered "real" armor.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
